item.title: Ukraine launches massive drone attack on Russia, hitting St Petersburg oil terminal
item.description: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks of the war on Russia overnight Saturday, striking the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and other targets in and around Russia's second-largest city. The attack killed at least one person and wounded five others, according to St. Petersburg Governor…

item.title: Fed's Warsh Avoids Signal on Rate Move as Inflation Persists
item.description: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said Friday he won't prejudge what the U.S. central bank will do about interest rates at its upcoming meetings in October and December, offering no fresh signals during a "fireside chat" with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva at…

item.title: French police arrest about 1,800 as protests turn violent across country
item.description: French police arrested about 1,800 people on Saturday as some 550,000 demonstrators took to the streets in nationwide protests that were largely peaceful but turned violent in parts of the country, leaving burnt-out cars, shattered shopfronts and looted stores across Paris and other cities.…

item.title: Big Tech earnings week ahead: Meta, Tesla, Netflix and others report as AI-boom costs weigh on markets
item.description: The third-quarter earnings season accelerates this week, with 70 S&P 500 companies reporting, led by a cluster of Big Tech names including Meta Platforms, Tesla and Netflix. The reports come after both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite fell last week as traders rotated out of technology stocks…
